video_title: DANILO GALLINARI, nos cuenta que es lo que más AMA DE MÉXICO y que opina de la NUEVA GENERACIÓN NBA.

quotes.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
quotes.summary_phrase: Danilo Gallinari on watching Jokic and Murray develop into stars
quotes.excerpt: to see the process and now to see them stars, champions, MVPs, is great to see.
quotes.quote: I enjoyed every year for different reasons. The first three years we were winning, fighting for a championship, and when you play for a winning team, it is fun to win. The last three or four years were more rebuilding, but I had the chance to play with Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray, who were my rookies in Denver. To see the process and now to see them stars, champions, MVPs, is great to see.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Disfruté cada año por diferentes razones. Los primeros tres años estuvimos ganando, peleando por un campeonato, y cuando ganas y juegas para un equipo ganador, ganar es de lo más divertido. Los últimos tres o cuatro años fueron más de reconstrucción, pero tuve la oportunidad de jugar con Nikola Jokic y Jamal Murray, que eran mis novatos en Denver, así que ver todo ese proceso y verlos ahora como estrellas, campeones y MVP, da muchísimo gusto verlo.
quotes.social_post: Danilo Gallinari reflects on his time in Denver watching Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray grow from rookies into champions and MVPs. It is great to see the process.

quotes.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
quotes.summary_phrase: Gallinari on Nikola Jokic's unique basketball IQ and playing style
quotes.excerpt: he sees things that regular people like us we don't see.
quotes.quote: I knew he was going to be a good player. I didn't know he was going to be the best player in the world, but he is. I usually tend to like players that don't run or jump as much as a lot of other players, and Nikola is the perfect example. But the way that he sees the game, he sees things that regular people like us we don't see.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Sabía que iba a ser un buen jugador. Lo que no sabía es que sería el mejor jugador del mundo. Pero lo es. A mí por lo regular me gustan los jugadores que no corren ni brincan tanto como muchos otros jugadores, y Nikola es el ejemplo perfecto. Pero por la forma en que ve el juego, ve cosas que la gente común y corriente como nosotros no ve.
quotes.social_post: Danilo Gallinari on Nikola Jokic: I knew he would be a good player, but I did not know he would be the best in the world. He sees things that regular people like us do not see.

quotes.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
quotes.summary_phrase: Danilo Gallinari builds his all-time starting five of former teammates
quotes.excerpt: I'll put Chris Paul at the one, Bogdanovic at the two, Andre Iguodala at the three, Stoudemire, Nene.
quotes.quote: This is a tough question, but for sure one of my best teammates ever, one of my best friends is Nene. I would definitely put Nene at the center. I'll put Chris Paul at the one, Bogdanovic at the two, Andre Iguodala at the three, Stoudemire at the four, and Nene at the five.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Está difícil la pregunta, pero sin duda tenemos a uno de mis mejores compañeros de equipo de siempre, de mis mejores amigos, es Nene. Sin duda pondría a Nene de centro. Pondría en el cuatro... voy a poner a Chris Paul en el uno, sí, a Bogdanovic lo pongo en el dos. Pondría en el tres... probablemente pondría a Andre Iguodala en el tres, en el cuatro a Stoudemire, y en el cinco, a Nene.
quotes.social_post: Danilo Gallinari builds his all time starting five of former teammates: Chris Paul, Bogdanovic, Andre Iguodala, Amar'e Stoudemire, and Nene.

quotes.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
quotes.summary_phrase: Gallinari on the mental adjustment required for the NBA schedule
quotes.excerpt: you have to get used to the schedule. In Italy I was playing once or twice a week.
quotes.quote: You have to get used to the schedule. In Italy I was playing once or twice a week. In the NBA you play three or four times a week with the traveling, 48 minutes against the best players in the world every night, so that is a big adjustment. So it is more mental than physical.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Te tienes que acostumbrar al ritmo de la agenda. En Italia yo jugaba una o dos veces por semana. En la NBA juegas tres o cuatro veces por semana, con todos los viajes encima, cuarenta y ocho minutos contra los mejores jugadores del mundo cada noche, así que sí es un ajuste enorme, así que es más un tema mental que físico.
quotes.social_post: Danilo Gallinari on the NBA transition: The schedule is a big adjustment. Playing three or four times a week with the traveling against the best players in the world is more mental than physical.

quotes.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
quotes.summary_phrase: Gallinari on the high level of competition across all NBA teams
quotes.excerpt: every team, even the team with the worst records, they have amazing players that every night.
quotes.quote: It is amazing. Every team, even the team with the worst records, they have amazing players that every night are showing their game and they could explode at any time.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: O sea, es impresionante. Cualquier equipo, hasta los que tienen el peor récord, cuentan con jugadores increíbles que noche tras noche salen a demostrar su nivel, y que te pueden explotar en cualquier momento.
quotes.social_post: Danilo Gallinari on the state of the league: It is amazing. Even the teams with the worst records have amazing players who could explode at any time.
